chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Learn three qualities from the crow: its concealment when mating, its early rising in seeking sustenance, and its cautiousness.

key_terms.الْغُرَابِ: The crow, presented here as an example from which lessons are drawn

ai.seo_question: What qualities does Imam عليه السلام say should be learned from the crow?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that beneficial lessons may be taken even from the behavior of animals. This narration highlights modesty, diligence in seeking livelihood, and caution as praiseworthy qualities to adopt.
